seoTitle: City River Tour Manchester | Sightseeing Cruise from Salford Quays
seoDescription: See Manchester from the water. Regular sightseeing cruises departing from Millennium Footbridge, Salford Quays M50 3RB. From £13. Book direct for best availability.
heading: City River Tour — Manchester Ship Canal
keyFacts: Heated cabin, open deck, licensed bar

sections.heading: Explore the route
body: This is a non-landing sightseeing cruise — you'll see all of this from the comfort of the boat, with live commentary throughout.
Follow the full Manchester Ship Canal route — tap a number for details, or read the sights in order below.

sections.heading: About the cruise
body: The City River Tour is our signature sightseeing cruise and the best way to see Manchester and Salford from the water. Settle into the heated cabin or take in the views from the deck as our crew share the stories behind the waterway.
sections.note: Full description, highlights and what's included — TBC from Simon (content-checklist.md).

sections.heading: Your route
body: The cruise follows the Manchester Ship Canal with live commentary at each landmark.
sections.note: 43 points of interest with live GPS commentary. The 12 highlights are flagged on the map and listed first below.

sections.heading: Make a day of it
body: Combine your cruise with these nearby attractions.

items.question: Where does the City River Tour depart from?
items.answer: Cruises depart from the Millennium Footbridge at Salford Quays (M50 3RB), beside MediaCityUK.
